apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Phone: Item before Product ID and Cost Basis before Qty on Outgoing Items; Re-calculate next to % of Market when the Sold Prices don't match Customer Paid; shorter Notes hint.

desktop.notes: Cash sales: the Discount % boxes are now % of Market (type 85 for 85% of Market Price). The Trade Summary still shows the Discount.
